items.observation: The integrity of the downloaded prebuilt binary is not verified. `nativeSourcesDigest` covers only the sources and the hook does not read it. A tampered release asset is loaded directly.
items.proposed_fix: Pin a SHA-256 for every release asset (produced by the CI binaries job), verify after download, fall back to a source build on mismatch; add a test.
items.closure_criteria: Every release asset carries a pinned SHA-256 produced by the CI binaries job and the hook verifies it after download. A mismatch triggers the source-build fallback and a test covers that path.

items.observation: A panic inside the crate terminates the process at the ABI boundary (unwinding out of extern C aborts since Rust 1.81). The C++ sibling shims catch the exception with `try/catch(...)` (re2_shim.cc:51-69; simdjson_shim.cpp:257-285). The effect was not exercised.
items.proposed_fix: Wrap every body with `std::panic::catch_unwind`, return null or false on panic (the Dart side already converts to StateError); publish with a `_version` and digest update.
items.closure_criteria: Every extern C body in native/tokenizers_ffi/src/lib.rs is wrapped in std::panic::catch_unwind and returns null or false on panic. The change ships with an updated _version tag and nativeSourcesDigest.

items.observation: `cargo build --release` builds into the package root with `workingDirectory: crateDir` (native/tokenizers_ffi/target/) and returns the binary from there; the package directory in the pub cache is modified.
items.closure_criteria: cargo build runs with --target-dir under input.outputDirectoryShared and the package directory in the pub cache stays unmodified.

items.observation: There is an unjustified `on Object { return false; }` inside `_download` [internal mapping: J10].
items.proposed_fix: Narrow it to `IOException`/`HttpException` or write a comment naming the reason.
items.closure_criteria: The catch in _download is narrowed to IOException or HttpException or carries a comment naming the accepted failure reasons.

items.observation: The native frees sit outside finally (fromBytes, idToToken, encode, encodeWithOffsets, decode). If an intermediate step throws, native memory leaks; the siblings use nested try/finally.
items.closure_criteria: fromBytes, idToToken, encode, encodeWithOffsets and decode release native memory inside nested try/finally blocks.

items.observation: `_allocUtf8` allocates at least 1 byte; `fromBytes` and `decode` call `calloc(0)` on empty input; there is no test.
items.closure_criteria: fromBytes and decode allocate at least one byte on empty input, matching _allocUtf8. Empty-input tests cover both entry points.

items.observation: There is no format check and `dart analyze` runs without --fatal-infos; both exist in all six siblings. `permissions: contents: write` is at the workflow level and the test job also runs with write permission.
items.proposed_fix: Add the format and --fatal-infos steps; move the write permission to the binaries job only.
items.closure_criteria: The CI workflow runs a format check and dart analyze with --fatal-infos. Only the binaries job holds the write permission.

items.observation: The hook's `buildCodeAssets` return and the download/source fallback are untested.
items.proposed_fix: A hook_test.dart based on the siblings' testBuildHook; a test of the code-asset-free path without network.
items.closure_criteria: test/hook_test.dart runs the hook without code assets and without network and covers the download and source fallback branches.

items.observation: Cargo.lock is missing from the hook's dependency list although the digest test hashes it; a lockfile change does not invalidate the hook cache.
items.closure_criteria: hook/build.dart lists crateDir.resolve('Cargo.lock') among its dependency inputs and a lockfile change invalidates the hook cache.

items.observation: The budget and chunking policy (about 200 lines, nested loops at 435-470) sits inside the FFI resource-owning Tokenizer class; the whole implementation is in the entry library (488 lines).
items.proposed_fix: Enter it in the debt register. Move the algorithms into `lib/src/token_budget.dart`, depending only on encode/encodeWithOffsets and preserving the public signatures; the methods delegate.
items.closure_criteria: The budget and chunking algorithms live in lib/src/token_budget.dart behind private helpers and depend only on encode and encodeWithOffsets. The public signatures are unchanged and test/token_budget_test.dart passes.

items.observation: The android/iOS error message shows only the repository address instead of a specific issue. MOBILE-FEASIBILITY.md (2026-08-29, 1.1.0 scope) goes into the archive and its version information is stale.
items.proposed_fix: Link it to a specific issue; update the report or add it to .pubignore.
items.closure_criteria: The android and iOS rejection message links a specific issue. MOBILE-FEASIBILITY.md is current or excluded from the published archive through .pubignore.
